say:2:1530229401:1.text: Yeah! We want to study there.
say:2:1530229401:1.source_cn: 是啊！我们想去那里求学。

say:3:1530229402:1.text: You know Merlin, the wise mage from Halia? She saved so many lives. She's my hero!
say:3:1530229402:1.source_cn: 你知道呼临城那位聪慧温柔的魔法师梅林吗？她救了很多人，...
say:3:1530229402:1.male: You know Merlin, the wise mage from Halia? She saved so many lives. She's my hero!
say:3:1530229402:1.female: You know Merlin, the wise mage from Halia? She saved so many lives. She's my hero!

say:4:1530229403:1.text: She trained at the Arcane Council. I want to find her and learn magic from her!
say:4:1530229403:1.source_cn: 她就来自这个协会。我想去找她，和她学习魔法！
say:4:1530229403:1.male: She trained at the Arcane Council. I want to find her and learn magic from her!
say:4:1530229403:1.female: She trained at the Arcane Council. I want to find her and learn magic from her!

say:5:1530229404:1.text: We want to be just like her. If we master magic, maybe we could conjure food out of thin air!
say:5:1530229404:1.source_cn: 我们想成为像她那样厉害的人。学成之后，说不定还能用魔法...
say:5:1530229404:1.male: We want to be just like her. If we master magic, maybe we could conjure food out of thin air!
say:5:1530229404:1.female: We want to be just like her. If we master magic, maybe we could conjure food out of thin air!

say:6:1530229405:1.text: Then no one would ever go hungry again...
say:6:1530229405:1.source_cn: 这样一来，说不定就不用饿肚子了……
say:6:1530229405:1.male: Then no one would ever go hungry again...
say:6:1530229405:1.female: Then no one would ever go hungry again...
